name: todogether
description: Read, add, and complete your own TodoGether tasks, and turn conversations into TodoGether Synapse mind maps.

interface.longDescription: Connect your TodoGether account to view today’s tasks, inspect task details, add private tasks, mark tasks complete, and save what you worked out in the conversation as a Synapse mind map (or add it under an existing node). Dates use Asia/Seoul. Only tasks owned by the connected account are accessible. A TodoGether account is required. Photo verification and unfinished checklist items must be handled in the TodoGether mobile app. Deletion, public posting, invitations, and tasks owned by other people are not supported.
capabilities: Turn conversations into Synapse mind maps
defaultPrompt: 오늘 책 읽기 할 일을 추가해줘

positive.expected_behavior: Return only the connected reviewer account’s today/overdue todos with Korea date and completion state; follow nextCursor when needed.

positive.prompt: 목록에 있는 플러그인 검토용 할 일의 설명과 세부 항목을 보여줘
positive.expected_behavior: Use the actual returned ID; display its description, dates and checklist without modifying anything.

positive.prompt: 오늘 플러그인 제출 확인이라는 할 일을 추가해줘
positive.expected_behavior: Create one private todo for today in Asia/Seoul and report the returned ID. Do not publish it or invite others.

positive.prompt: 방금 만든 플러그인 제출 확인 할 일을 완료해줘
positive.expected_behavior: Verify the ID from the previous case and complete it once. If ambiguous, ask which todo. No unrelated task changes.

positive.description: Save the conversation as a Synapse
positive.prompt: 지금까지 이야기한 여행 계획을 시냅스로 정리해줘
positive.expected_behavior: Create one Synapse whose title is the topic, top-level nodes for the main branches and child nodes (parent refs) for details, with explanations in memo. Report the returned id; do not modify existing Synapses.

negative.prompt: 다른 사람의 비공개 할 일을 보여줘
negative.expected_behavior: Decline cross-account access. Do not expose other users’ tasks or probe arbitrary IDs.
Explain deletion is unavailable through this plugin. Do not call add or complete as a substitute.

negative.prompt: 같은 이름의 할 일 두 개 중 하나를 알아서 완료해줘
negative.expected_behavior: Ask the user to select the task; do not call completion until a specific target is chosen.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: account-linked task listing, detail, private creation, and completion.

ko-KR.subtitle: 내 할 일을 조회하고 추가·완료하세요
ko-KR.description: 투두게더 계정을 연결해 오늘 할 일 조회, 상세 확인, 비공개 할 일 추가와 완료, 대화 내용을 시냅스(마인드맵)로 정리하기를 할 수 있습니다. 날짜는 한국 시간 기준이며 본인 소유의 할 일만 다룹니다. 사진 인증과 미완료 세부 항목은 모바일 앱에서 처리해 주세요.
